== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Imperial Detainment (Errata)]] (<code>1210_43</code>, Virtual Block 1 slip 38E), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-38E-Imperial_Detainment.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-imperialdetainment-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Imperial Detainment]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), official text as of 27 April 2013 ([[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf]]; preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]). The ▼ arrow and the Immune to Alter icon are drawn as on the printed slip (caption •First Strike (V), slip 38E).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. We Have A Prisoner is a Used Interrupt. TIEs are deploy +1 to Launch Bay. During your deploy phase, may deploy from Reserve Deck (or retrieve) one Besieged or a Launch Bay; reshuffle. Once per turn, when your Imperial captures (seizes) a character, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker), STANDARD rev 71: the card's own Virtual Legacy card (same Decipher art, frame, lore, icons, slip number and Virtual Block 1 set mark as the printed card) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
